content.title: AKU and DW sign a memorandum of understanding to develop world-class professional development programmes in East Africa
content.summary: The Aga Khan University and Deutsche Welle have made a commitment to cooperate and support the development and delivery of world-class professional development programmes for Aga Khan University Graduate School of Media and Communications.

media.alt: AKU and DW sign a memorandum of understanding to develop world-class professional development programmes in East Africa

content.text: The Aga Khan University (AKU) and Deutsche Welle (DW) have made a commitment to cooperate and support the development and delivery of world-class professional development programmes for Aga Khan University Graduate School of Media and Communications (AKU-GSMC).
A memorandum of understanding was signed by Firoz Rasul, President, AKU and Peter Limbourg, Director, Deutsche Welle at a ceremony on the School's campus in Nairobi.

The partnership brings together two leading institutions focused on building capacity and expertise in media and communications. DW Akademie, the international media development and training division of DW, will leverage over 50 years experience training aspiring journalists and media professionals across multimedia platforms. Together, AKU-GSMC and DW Akademie will deliver world-class professional development programmes for media professionals in East Africa.

"We are very pleased to join efforts with AKU-GSMC. Strengthening human rights through media development is at the core of the undertaking. We look forward to bringing this project to fruition," said Mr Limbourg.
AKU-GSMC offers professional development, executive leadership and graduate programmes to media and communication professionals in East Africa.

"This is a terrific example of how two very different media organizations - one an innovative academic institution, the other a premier global media leader - can work together to deliver the highest-standard media education and training across East Africa," said Michael Meyer, Dean, AKU-GSMC and a former Newsweek editor and director of communications for UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon.

The partnership has been made possible thanks to the support of the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), the German Development Bank (KFW) and the East African Community (EAC).

AKU-GSMC's mission is to foster a diverse, independent, innovative, ethical and economically thriving media and communications sector that contributes to the creation of successful and sustainable societies in an era of technological and social change.

DW Akademie is Germany's leading organization for international media development. It supports the development of independent, transparent media systems, quality journalism and media expertise. They help rebuild media in post-crisis and post-conflict environments and contribute internationally to the professional training of media workers.
